requirement: Keep the gas path to the nozzles closed unless two independent channels both authorise it
Authorise thrust only with driver consent, an authorised zone confirmed by two independent sources and passed pre-arm checks
Accept thrust commands only from authenticated sources inside the thrust domain
Contain the stored gas under all foreseeable pressure, temperature and impact loads
On crash or fire, isolate every vessel and vent only without net thrust
Maintain steering control (allocated to the steer-by-wire item; outside this item)
Detect loss of downforce and limit speed and cornering before grip is exceeded
Detect asymmetric thrust during a launch and stop it
Start a manoeuvre only when the remaining gas can finish it after one fault
Respond to any in-flight fault with recovery to an upright landing, never with loss of all thrust
Isolate a faulty thruster path and compensate with the others
Estimate attitude, height and gas state with tolerance to one sensor fault
Refuse to arm unless the clear zone is empty and wind is within limits
Arm external airbags only in Hop mode above 1.5 m
